1840 as the starting point of modern design history: all six volumes assert the break but none supplies a design indicator that changes at that date; the consequence judgments differ (decline / destruction / transition boundary / treaty-port starting point)
Zhao Nong's volume internally gives both 1840 and 1842 for the Opium War; the batch records both and adjudicates neither

Early industrialization: Li Lixin gives no start/end dates, regional variation, output or capital statistics, and no item-by-item comparison with European proto-industrialization; what counts as a 'necessary condition' is not spelled out
No source text stages a direct confrontation between 'early industrialization' and '1840 as starting point'; the Topic juxtaposes them without a synthesis
Lin Zexu rests on a single sentence with confidence low; no office, prohibition process, quantity destroyed or subsequent exile
Wei Yuan: no official career, bibliography, periodization of thought, or Haiguo Tuzhi edition; 'looking at the world and advocating reform' is Zhao Nong's evaluative phrasing
Haiguo Tuzhi's ten-item imitation list gives object names only, with no form, dimension, use or record of success; the 'from military to civilian' reading is the KU's own judgment
Feng Guifen's three-stage self-strengthening ideal is a single quotation; no link to the Self-Strengthening clique's actual practice
No source establishes a teacher-student or influence lineage among Lin, Wei and Feng; the 'lineage' is Zhao Nong's narrative arrangement

Self-Strengthening Movement: 2016 calls it the soil of modern design, Zhao Nong calls it 'Chinese learning as essence, Western learning for use' and 'strengthening the government, not the people'; neither side offers measurable criteria
Jiawu naval battle: one sentence only; no belligerents, theatre, ships, forces, Gregorian year or course of battle; the 'endless harm to later economic reform' judgment has no evidence chain
Xinhai Revolution: 2016 gives political and economic consequences without data; Zhao Nong only makes it the starting point of the Jianshe Fanglue; no intermediary to design institutions
Kang Youwei: two painting-program phrases only, transmitted by Zhao Nong rather than quoted from Kang; no source, date or full text, and no link to design practice
No source text connects the Xinhai Revolution with Kang Youwei; the juxtaposition in E.4.4 is the batch's framework
